verdict.rationale: Community evidence shows Mistral Large 3 listed on an independent third-party leaderboard (LMArena, rank 28 with a cited ELO), so the model does appear outside vendor-run numbers. That is a single community-reported data point, and no first-party or broader independent sources confirm coverage across other evaluations. Missing for 10: multiple independent leaderboards or evaluations beyond LMArena, coverage of other Mistral models, and direct links to third-party evaluation results rather than secondhand community mentions.

support.subject: As a founder, the model shows up in independent third-party evaluations and leaderboards, so I am not relying only on vendor-run numbers

citations.quote: Mistral Large 3 is ranked 28 on LMArena, behind other SOTA models, though the ELO gap (1418 vs 1491) is relatively small
